name: crash-ai-crashsight
title: CrashAI CrashSight MCP
description: Fast Rust-backed CrashSight fact collector. It scans CrashSight upload records concurrently, aggregates by issue/platform/application version, enriches issue details and Redmine, and returns a direct Markdown report plus same-response context for Agent analysis.
author: AIINWORK
capabilities: Direct Markdown report and same-response context output for Agent analysis
Issue rows are aggregated by issue, platform, and application version
Legacy CrashSight tools retained for compatibility
